current_profile_snapshot.groove_behavior: swing or straight big-band groove with sectional figures and rhythm-section continuity
current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: 8/16-bar phrases, ensemble punches, call-response sections, build toward shout/feature passages
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: jazz tonal/extended harmony with arranged voicings and sectional voice leading
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: walking or riff-based bass tied to drums and ensemble figures
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: ride/backbeat support, setup fills and ensemble hits; accents align with horn figures
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: sax section, trumpets, trombones, piano/guitar, bass, drum kit; optional clarinet/flute doubles
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: sections phrase as units; brass/reeds balance and articulate together
current_profile_snapshot.arrangement_transformation: introductions, ensemble choruses, solos, backgrounds and climactic ensemble returns
current_profile_snapshot.dynamic_behavior: large sectional contrasts with controlled crescendos into ensemble hits
current_profile_snapshot.articulation_behavior: tight staccato/accented figures contrasted with legato section pads
current_profile_snapshot.timing_humanization_behavior: section-coherent placement; brass/reed attacks align with intentional pushes/lays
current_profile_snapshot.continuous_performance_control: section expression and articulation controls plus solo-feature dynamics
current_profile_snapshot.sound_effects_intent: natural room with limited enhancement; avoid smearing ensemble attacks
current_profile_snapshot.mix_prominence_intent: rhythm section foundation; featured section/solo foreground; backgrounds subordinate
current_profile_snapshot.production_mastering_intent: retain punch and brass detail without harshness
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires reliable section/ensemble patch mapping and articulation control
